t: The Fractal Unfurling: Pipulate's AI-First Approach to Data-Driven Video Workflows
s: This article details Pipulate's AI-first engineering approach, focusing on 'fractal unfurling' of intelligence for complex data-driven video workflows, challenging paradigms like Docker and 'Peak Data Theory' by emphasizing Python/HTMX over JavaScript full stacks and Nix over Docker.
sub: Critique of Docker and Peak Data Theory
